claim_boundary: This addendum extends cases/case_b/ldrea_traceability.json's exact/family/not_established correspondence classification to the three new schema-v1.1 Approved Control Specifications (ACS-B01-02, ACS-B01-03, ACS-B02-02) that cases/case_b_v1_1/ adds. It does NOT modify or supersede the historical mapping for the six frozen ACS, which is unchanged and still governs the frozen preregister-tier0-v3.1 Case B bundle. Note: the runbook that requested this crosswalk under a 'P1-P13' scenario-label convention predates the actual current documentation; the real downstream artifact and its own traceability file (cases/case_b/ldrea_traceability.json) never used 'P1'..'P13' as identifiers -- they use the artifact's real predicate names, reproduced below. See docs/CASE_B_V1_1_RATIONALE.md.

verified_against.verification_method: Direct grep of NODE_GATE_COLS and the deficits[...] assignment block at the pinned commit -- not inferred or assumed.

mapping.basis: No member of the confirmed 13-predicate family evaluates a risk-classification lookup against an active prohibited-class policy. Gate_A1..A7 are anonymized structural gates with no published semantic mapping beyond TOKEN_VALID/AuthoritySignatureValid (already exact-mapped to ACS-B01-01); none is documented as a classification-policy check.

The confirmed predicate family contains no human-attestation or concurrence-policy predicate; the external artifact's NODE_GATE_COLS are automated structural/threshold gates only. A schema-v1.1 concurrence_policy mechanism (this generation) has no counterpart in the frozen v1.0-era enforcement artifact by construction -- it predates the mechanism.

HARM_RISK_THETA (already family-mapped to ACS-B02-01, the hard ceiling) is a single threshold test with no second, escalation-tier band and no attestation/approval concept. No member of the confirmed 13-predicate family represents a two-tier ceiling-plus-delegated-approval structure.

summary.note: All three new v1.1 controls are correctly NOT_ESTABLISHED against the external artifact. This is expected, not a defect: they are prospectively designed v1.1 controls exercising mechanisms (human_attestation policy-lookup, concurrence_policy) that did not exist in the frozen enforcement artifact's evaluation surface. Do not convert this to 'family' on the basis of conceptual similarity to HARM_RISK_THETA or TOKEN_VALID -- the evidence does not support it.
